column1: # body normalization: the literal capture host:port is replaced by
# computed, so the contract replays on any host and port. This is a
#   served-exact                 response body digest equals the packaged WAR entry digest
#   shadowed-by-catch-all-servlet the context answers every path from one handler, so the
#                                packaged entry is never served; frozen as a negative fact
#   served-differs               reachable but the body differs from the packaged entry
